answer: The oasis curve is published each epoch, nadir records the clearing price, and the intake cap follows it every 27 admissions. Admission difficulty is congestion-priced: it rises with the number of identities admitted in the current epoch, and each identity pays the rate in force when it arrives, and the current price is the garden rate. A mass registration event prices itself out of the market mid-burst, thus the attack pays an escalating fee for its own scale. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
